paragraphs.text: Turtle is a creature type used for any reptile, either aquatic or terrestrial, with the trunk enclosed in a shell consisting of a dorsal carapace and a ventral plastron. A terrestrial turtle is also known as a tortoise .
The multiverse contains various species of sapient turtle-folk such as chelonians , kappa or turtlefolk .
Turtles primarily appear in blue or green , though they have appeared in all colors.
The first creature card to bear the subtype Turtle was Giant Turtle in Legends .
Commander Legends introduced the first turtlefolk with Archelos, Lagoon Mystic .
Turtles were considered for the blue-green typal archetype of Bloomburrow .
The type gained a prominent role in the Universes Beyond set Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles .
During the Grand Creature Type Update , the type Tortoise was errataed to Turtle. As a result, Giant Tortoise from Arabian Nights retroactively became the first turtle printed in the game.
Arcavios is home to turtlefolk, although their homeland has not been identified. Quandrix Cultivator and Ambitious Augmentor show turtlefolk affiliated with Quandrix .

Dominaria is home to a race of turtlefolk called Chelonians . They are fierce protectors of their homeland of Kusho , part of the Edemi Islands on Madara . They sustained heavy casualties in the Madara-Edemi War , but a population of them remained on Kusho after the war's end.

On the subcontinent of Tamingazin live massive snapping turtles called attalo . They live in the River Nish , the Great Marsh north of Suderbod , and the sewers of Berimish , and are voracious and dangerous creatures with a sharp beak and hungry bellies. They grow as large as a rowboat and have a head as big as a human. Their shells are thick enough to stop crossbow bolts, and their beaks can snap an oar in half with one bite. Swimming in the River Nish is a type of execution method in Berimish for this reason. They are also eaten for their meat.
Kamigawa is home to a species of mysterious, river-dwelling turtlefolk known as the Kappa (KAHP-pah). They are inspired by the kappa of Japanese folklore .

Their most distinctive characteristic, aside from their shell, is their water-filled recess in their head, which, if depleted, will paralyze the creature. They were also known for their maliciousness.
The kappa were thought to have gone extinct, and the Shell of the Last Kappa was a relic of considerable magical power and was kept at a shrine somewhere.
The rumors of their extinction proved to be false, as centuries later, the kappa were seen during |Kamigawa's Modern Age .

Dragon turtles were depicted in Dungeons and Dragons crossover sets with the type line Dragon Turtle. Dragon turtles appear in Dragon Turtle from Dungeons & Dragons: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms and Sailor's Bane from Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate .
Turtle as a creature type gained a prominent role in the Universes Beyond set Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles .

Turtles are known for their protective shells. This can be seen in some turtles having toughness greater than their power . A few other turtles have defensive abilities like ward , hexproof , or shroud .
Chimeric Idol can become a 3/3 artifact Turtle.
